checks.check: Exact artifact set: seven lessons and seventy blocks
checks.evidence: The three artifacts contain exactly 7 distinct lesson IDs and 70 blocks; each lesson has the ten canonical kinds in the required order.

All 70 blocks contain distinct Vietnamese and English learner-facing prose. Requirements, designs, prompts, hints, feedback, retrieval answers, diagnosis and repair are localized; executable Python, fixtures, trace states and reference IDs remain shared as allowed by the bilingual contract.

All 7 worked examples contain localized requirement and design, non-empty Python, trace, expected output, at least two tests and evidence reference IDs. The rebuilt registry retains these fields under content.vi.workedExample and content.en.workedExample.

Every lesson contains exactly three ordered practice items with stable IDs, prompt, hint, expected artifact, reveal condition, repair feedback and an explicitly AlgoCore-authored rubric. The registry retains all three items in both locales.

Every lesson contains a reconstruction prompt, hidden answer, reveal condition, first-error diagnosis, repair step and AlgoCore-authored retrieval rubric; the registry retains the structured payload in both locales.

Each marking chain resolves internally to a QP requirement reference and either a verified MS atom or an explicitly AlgoCore-authored rubric. Every chain sets noInventedOfficialMarks=true and no numeric official mark is invented.

checks.check: Exact Stage 3 pattern ownership against rebuilt registry
checks.evidence: Exact set equality holds for all seven lessons: oop-model {OOP_CLASS,OOP_INSTANTIATE}; oop-state {OOP_GET,OOP_SET,OOP_UPDATE}; oop-inheritance {OOP_OVERRIDE,OOP_SUBCLASS}; oop-aggregation {OOP_CAPACITY_ADD}; text-files {FILE_READ_ARRAY,FILE_WRITE}; object-files {FILE_READ_OBJECTS}; exam-workflow {EVIDENCE_RUN,MAIN_FLOW,OUTPUT_FORMAT}. Order differences are ignored because ownership is a set.

checks.check: Every block reference ID exists in its artifact source catalog
checks.evidence: All sourceRefs used by the 70 blocks resolve to a refId declared in the corresponding artifact source_catalog.

checks.check: Every source catalog locator resolves to an existing source file and target
checks.evidence: Recheck after S9R2-OOP-F001 remediation resolves 42/42 catalog locators. The four OOP lessons target s6-e/METHOD_EXPLANATIONS.json, text-files and object-files target s6-f/LESSON_SKELETON_MANIFEST.json, and exam-workflow targets s6-g/LESSON_SKELETON_MANIFEST.json. The rebuilt registry contains zero references to missing files across the 70 reviewed blocks.
For all seven lessons the registry preserves workedExample, practiceItems, retrievalItem and markingChain in both locale payloads, as well as exact lesson-level pattern ownership.
